full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Nuruzzaman, J:- The instant application has been filed by one Md. Zamal Sheikh under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure against the Judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 30.06.2009 passed by Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribunal (Additional Sessions Judge) Munshigonj in Nari-O-Shihsu Case No.49 of 2005 convicting the petitioner under Section 9(1) of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 (Amended 2003) sentencing him to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Tk.10,000/- (ten thousand) in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for one year and at his instance on 10.01.2012 the instant Rule was issued. 

 2. The prosecution case in short are that the Opposite Party No.2 filed complaint case being Nari-O-Shishu Case No. 49 of 2005 alleging, inter alia, that the accused is a man of caddish character and woman tyrant as a man of rascal. Victim Sahara Begum is mother in law of the complainant. On 04.05.2005 the accused took the victim to his rented house at 34, Lutfar Rahman lane in Dhaka for giving some money on loan. Thereafter, the convict petitioner went out from his house and after coming back at 10.00 P.M he committed rape up to 12:00 p.m. against her will. Thereafter victim was confined in that house by some unknown miscreants with serious injury. On the following day on 05.05.2005 the victim fled away from the convict petitioner's house 1 with the help of a unknown person. After reaching her house she disclosed the fact of rape to her near relatives and took first aid. On 06.05.2005 a compromise meeting was held wherein the accused in presence of the some Arbiters orally admitted the facts and thereafter the accused had given writing in stamp that he will obey the decision of the Arbiters. However, soon after the above decision some disobedient persons pros pond the meeting and accused fled away from the meeting. Therefore, the Arbiters were not able to take final decision due to prevailing situation of the place of meeting. Thereafter she got herself admitted into the Dhaka Medical College and Hospital. Subsequently, the complainant as a son-in-law of the victim filed the instant case under Section 9(1) of Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Damon Ain, 2000(amended-2003). 

 4. The case was transmitted to the court of Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Tribunal (District and Sessions Judge), Munshigonj. Eventually, the instant case was transferred to the court of Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribunal (Additional District Judge), Munshigonj and renumbered as Nari-O-Shishu Case No. 49 of 2015. The learned Judge of the Tribunal passed the Judgment and order of conviction dated 30.08.2009 convicting the said accused-Jamal Sheikh under Section 9(1) of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000(amendment-2003) and thereby sentencing him to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Tk. 10,000/-, in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 01 (one) year. 

 6. In such situation the convict-petitioner filed the instant Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2666 of 2012 under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure as the statutory period of appeal has already been expired earlier. 

 অতপর উভয় আসামী ঢাকা জেলা কারাগারে আটক থাকায় তাদের উপস্থিতির জন্য পি.ডব্লিউ ইস্যু করা হয়। সাজা প্রাপ্ত আসামীর সংশ্লিষ্টতায় মহামান্য উচ্চাদালত Criminal Miscellaneous 2666/2012নং মামলায় মূল নথি প্রেরিত হওয়ায় উক্ত আদেশের কপি মহাত্ননের অবগতি ও প্রয়োজনীয় ব্যবস্থা গ্রহনের জন্য গত ৫/১২/২০১৬ ইং তারিখের প্রেরণ করা হয়েছিল। (কপি সংযুক্ত) 

 এই অবস্থায় মহামান্য উচ্চাদালতের Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2666 of 2012নং মামলার গত ২৩/৮/২০১৬ ইং তারিখের আদেশটি স্মারক নং ৯৯২৬১ তারিখ ০৮/৯/২০১৬ মূলে পাওয়া যায়। উক্ত আদেশ দৃষ্টে দেখা যায় যে, মহামান্য উচ্চাদালত দন্ডপ্রাপ্ত আসামী মোঃ জামাল শেখ, পিতা- সাকিম আলীকে অত্র ট্রাইব্যুনালের সন্তুষ্টক্রমে ৬(ছয়) মাসের জন্য জামিন প্রদান করেছেন। মহামান্য উচ্চাদালতের ২৩/৮/২০১৬ ইং তারিখের আদেশে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে। 

 In such situation the Hon'ble Chief Justice sent the instant Criminal Miscellaneous Case to this Bench for hearing and disposal of the same. 

 12. It further reveals from the report of the Judge of the Nari-O-Shishu Tribunal that as per his direction the Bench Assistant of the Tribunal, has already lodged an FIR regarding fraud activities against the real Zamal Sheikh and swindler Zamal Sheikh which has been recorded as Munshigonj Police Station Case No. 50 dated 27.09.2016 under Sections 205/419/109 of the Penal Code. The said Police case shall he proceed in accordance with Law. 

 15. We are further of the view that since swindler Zamal Sheikh is not convict and order of conviction and sentence was not passed against him. Therefore, the Swindler Zamal Sheikh alias Nasir Uddin alias Khokon be released from the charge of order of the conviction and sentence of the Nari-O-Shishu Case No. 49 of 2005 under section 9(1) of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Dhaman Ain, 2000 (amended in 2003) passed by the Nari-O-Shishu Daman Tribunal, (Additional Session Judge) Munshigonj on 30.06.2009 forthwith. However his trial inMunshigonj Police Station Case No. 5U dated 27.09.2016 will continue in accordance with law.
